listing.name: Saints Row (2006) — Saints Row (Xbox 360, 2006) — Static Recompilation (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: The alpha reaches the menu and New Game. The first mission, combat and vehicles remain untested. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Saints Row (2006) Xbox 360 disc ISO or extracted full disc files. NTSC-U title 545107D1.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Run Setup.cmd with your own NTSC-U Saints Row disc to build the tools, SDK and game code. A ready-to-run release is not available through this guide.

warnings: The alpha reaches the menu and New Game. The first mission, combat and vehicles remain untested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
